prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone transparent face decal artwork for a classic block-shaped Roblox character in Cloverboyz, a pixel-style Black Clover fantasy RPG.
Primary request: ONE determined youthful anime face, front-on, consisting ONLY of two eyes, two eyebrows and a small closed mouth. No head or skin. Strong focused emerald-green eyes, warm ivory sclera, near-black pupils, angular ink-dark brows tilted slightly inward, small confident closed smile. Both eyes look directly forward. Gender-neutral.
Style/medium: deliberate low-resolution pixel art, clean square pixel clusters, restrained 16-bit JRPG shading, sharp stepped outlines, approximately a 64x64 logical pixel design enlarged cleanly. Limited palette: warm black #191C19, muted emerald #527E5A, deep forest #304E3A, warm ivory #E4DDC0. No antialiasing or blur.
Composition/framing: square canvas. Face features centered as one cohesive face. Left eye centered at 35% width, right eye at 65%, eyes at 43% height; eyebrows at 33%; mouth at 65%. Entire artwork stays within middle 64% width and middle 46% height, leaving generous transparent margins for head mapping. Eyes have identical scale. No perspective.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent alpha everywhere except the face features, including between the eyes and inside surrounding empty space. Do not draw a head, skin-colored rectangle, nose, hair, ears, neck or body. This image will overlay different skin colors.
Text: none. Avoid logos, borders, checkerboard graphics, UI, labels, watermark, glow, gradients, shadows outside the features, extra faces or contact sheets.
